Additionally, based on our previous experience, one of the effective solutions for this type of error was replacing the CORA10 card reader.

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0478068
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Engie Vianeo
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PN 312562229/15
Charger ID / Serial No.:
XElPaO
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Customer complains about per Authorization error issue. Customer reported that same issue solved by Antoine Brua ( ID0325460). Please send a technician and try to do the following trouble shooting.
When starting a transaction, the terminal at first performs an action called "pre-processing" to determine which applications (read: AmEx, Mastercard, Visa, ...) and technologies (contactless chip, contacted chip and magstripe) are available.
This is based on the available card readers (i.e. COR for contactless chip processing, SCR for contacted chip and magstripe) and the applications listed in the EMV configuration.
Effectively, the terminal creates the intersection of "available technologies" and "available applications"; this is called the "candidate list".
So if either no card reader is available or the EMV configuration is empty/missing, this leads to an empty candidate list. In this case, the transaction request is immediately aborted.
This means that either the Card Reader might be defect or the terminal has "wrong" configurations (or none at all). The following actions may solve this problem:
The issue was opened for clarification of the error "preauthorize status error. Error message: Terminal candidate list empty". I brought the topic to R&D in the past weeks, so that they were able to discuss it with CCV, and this is the reply we received from CCV:
The terminal must be "forced" to fetch configurations from the host. E.g. re-commissioning, "diagnostics" with TS3 tool or asking CCV.
Card reader needs to be replaced.
Unfortunately, if none of the above helps, R&D suggests that you get in contact with CCV, as from our side we have no saying in this error, but is CCV who must definitely assist.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
